Additionally, resolve the internal contradiction in the 02:26 entry: the stewart_read criticizes the rep for not seeking alternatives while the alternative_hypothesis simultaneously claims the rep handled it correctly and efficiently — pick one reading and make the coaching_implication consistent with it. Also reconcile script_coverage's 'alternative_offered'/'declined' coding for the roof section with the narrative sections (trajectory_verdict, cherry_pick_moments, coaching_focus) which all describe this as a knowledge-gap/improvised-answer moment rather than a customer declining an offered alternative — these should tell the same story. Finally, consider adding the two missed moments (garbled intro at 00:11, and customer's self-resolved map friction at 01:08) to cherry_pick_moments/state_changes for a fuller picture, though these are secondary to the required fixes above.
